items.title: Universally injective structure morphism in the vanishing situation, by separating the closed points of two rational points

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that in the vanishing situation the structure morphism to the affine base is universally injective (statement lines 3096-3100). The proof reduces to a field valued base change, enlarges the field so that rational points cover the space, and then shows that two rational points cannot be distinct: they are closed points, and the separating function provided by the vanishing situation would then separate their images in the spectrum of the field, which is impossible. The reduction to rational points and the separation argument are the substance, so the claim is H2.
